title: Practical Python for Everyday Tasks
summary: A 4-week practical guide to mastering Python for automation, data handling, and problem solving, tailored for self-paced study.

days.title: Setting Up and Printing
objectives: Run basic Python commands in an interactive shell
Print formatted output to the console

days.title: Variables and Basic Math
objectives: Store values in variables using descriptive names
Perform arithmetic operations on numbers

days.title: Working with Strings
objectives: Manipulate text using string methods
Format strings using f-strings

days.title: User Input and Type Conversion
objectives: Capture input from the user
Convert data types between strings and numbers

days.title: Booleans and Comparisons
objectives: Evaluate comparison and logical operators
Store boolean states in variables

days.title: Conditional Statements
objectives: Write if-elif-else branches to control execution flow
Evaluate complex conditions securely

days.title: Introduction to Lists
objectives: Create and modify lists with items
Access list elements using positive and negative indexing

days.title: For Loops
objectives: Iterate over items in a list using for loops
Generate sequences of numbers using the range function

days.title: While Loops
objectives: Write while loops for condition-based repetition
Prevent infinite loops using break statements

days.title: Dictionaries for Key-Value Data
objectives: Store structured data using dictionaries
Access and update dictionary values

days.title: Defining Functions
objectives: Write reusable code blocks using custom functions
Pass arguments and return values from functions

days.title: Scope and Default Arguments
objectives: Distinguish between local and global variable scope
Define functions with default argument values

days.title: List Comprehensions
objectives: Write concise list transformations using list comprehensions
Filter lists efficiently in a single line of code

days.title: Error and Exception Handling
objectives: Catch runtime errors using try-except blocks
Handle multiple specific exceptions gracefully

days.title: Reading and Writing Text Files
objectives: Open, read, and write text files using context managers
Process file contents line by line

days.title: Using Built-in Modules
objectives: Import and use standard library modules like math and random
Work with dates and times using the datetime module

days.title: Working with CSV Data
objectives: Parse and analyze tabular data from CSV files
Write processed data back into a CSV format

days.title: Building Command Line Arguments
objectives: Accept command line inputs using sys.argv
Build a small script that takes parameters from the terminal

days.title: Writing Clean Code and Tests
objectives: Format code using PEP 8 style guidelines
Write simple assertion tests to verify function correctness

days.title: Automation Capstone Project
objectives: Combine loops, files, and functions into a complete utility script
Automate a repetitive text-processing task from scratch
